Roster page: three concepts

The same Roster page built three ways in the locked look (Book the show and the desk concept). Each combines what needs you with the roster by spot on the card. Scores are the median of two independent critics after five rounds; the bar is 8.5. Figures are stand-ins for the game's paper dolls. Pick one in chat.

1

Tabs on the wall

8.1median of two critics
(8.3 / 7.9)
  • The "Needs you" tab is strong: worst first, chances, what helps and hurts, and Coming up.
  • The "By spot" tab shows the best spot numbers: count, open spots, faces and heels, pay a week.
  • Weak: the two tabs mean problems and roster balance are never on screen together, and By spot repeats the list.
2

Split wall

7.5median of two critics
(7.7 / 7.3)
  • Problems on top and the whole roster by spot underneath, on one screen.
  • Weak: only four problems fit; two hide behind "+2 more", and Coming up is gone.
  • Weak: the name chips repeat the list and give no counts or pay.
3

Grouped list

8.4median of two critics
(8.5 / 8.3)
  • Each window does one job: the list shows spots with counts and open places, the wall shows every problem plus Coming up, the right pane shows the picked person.
  • Nothing is repeated, and it uses only pieces from the art bible.
  • To fix: plain words in the group headings ("2 faces, 2 heels") with pay, clipped rating badges, and the card buttons matching the right pane.

Critic notes and every score are in the repository: docs/notes/critic-log.md.
